messages.author: 896bac97953cfe04
messages.subject: Error: Failed to install 'MetaboAnalystR' from GitHub:   System command 'Rcmd.exe' failed, exit status: -1, stdout + stderr empty
parts:
Hi all !

I am downloading package 'MetaboAnalystR' from GitHub using this command:

devtools::install_github("xia-lab/MetaboAnalystR", build = TRUE, build_vignettes = FALSE)

But it seems like devtools were not able to download it, as I got this error:

Error: Failed to install 'MetaboAnalystR' from GitHub:
  System command 'Rcmd.exe' failed, exit status: -1, stdout + stderr empty

 Any help/suggestion would be extremely appreciated. Thanks !
